title: objectives
description: research/objectives.json (Implementation Decision 17): the questions the research answers, written only by code through the ledger and rendered as research/OBJECTIVES.md. Ids run O1 onward and are never reused; an objective is never deleted, only parked, answered, dropped, or reframed. An objective with a measure is a goal, and it has at most one.

text.description: the question, in the owner's words

answer.description: null while open; how it was answered, or why it was parked or dropped

items.description: a locator in the provenance linter's res: or ref: form

reframed_as.description: the objective that replaced this one, when reframed

measure.description: what lets code read a goal's progress; it stands only when its eval_command printed the metric on a sample artifact

metric.description: the name the eval command prints the value under

direction.description: up when a larger value is better

held_out_split.description: the split a kept change must improve on

eval_command.description: a shell command run from the project root; {artifact} is replaced by the artifact's quoted path, also exported as WAYLINE_ARTIFACT

source.description: where the number comes from: a paper, a result file, a run

dataset_or_split.description: the data the metric is computed on (descriptive)

min_seeds.description: the seeds keep-if-better needs for this goal, down to 1 for a deterministic computation; null takes policy.goal.min_seeds
